overview: A world-class travel and trekking website for Shail Hikers with 14 trek routes, 4 sacred yatras, full booking system, and admin tools — redesigned with a clean Summer Breeze palette.
features: 14 Himalayan trek detail pages with 12 tabs each
Email booking confirmations for trekkers and admin
Waitlist system for sold-out batches with auto-notifications
Admin panel with guide assignment and batch management
User dashboard with bookings, documents, wishlist, and referrals
Interactive batch calendar and weather integration
Gallery, blog, team, corporate, and contact pages
